title: Café en Madrid
blurb: Marta works in a small café in Madrid. One morning a new customer walks in. A gentle story about work, coffee and getting to know someone — read it at your level.

lines.en: Marta works in a café in Madrid.
The café is called Café Luna.
It's small but very nice.
Every morning Marta opens the café at seven.
Today a new man comes in.
He's tall and has brown hair.

lines.speaker: Marta
lines.en: "Good morning," says Marta.

lines.speaker: Daniel
lines.en: "Good morning. I want a coffee, please," says the man.

lines.speaker: Marta
lines.en: "Do you want a black coffee or with milk?"

lines.speaker: Daniel
lines.en: "With milk, please. And a croissant."

lines.speaker: Marta
lines.en: "Of course. Are you new in the neighbourhood?"

lines.speaker: Daniel
lines.en: "Yes, I live here now. I work in an office near here."

lines.speaker: Daniel
lines.en: "I'm Daniel," says the man.

lines.speaker: Marta
lines.en: "Nice to meet you. I'm Marta."
Marta prepares the coffee.
Daniel sits at a table by the window.
He drinks his coffee slowly and reads the newspaper.

lines.speaker: Daniel
lines.en: "The coffee is very good," says Daniel.

lines.speaker: Marta
lines.en: "Thank you. See you tomorrow?"

lines.speaker: Daniel
lines.en: "Yes, see you tomorrow," says Daniel with a smile.
The next day Daniel returns to the café.
Marta sees him and smiles.

lines.speaker: Marta
lines.en: "Good morning, Daniel," says Marta.

lines.speaker: Daniel
lines.en: "Good morning. How are you?"

lines.speaker: Marta
lines.en: "Very well, thank you. The same as yesterday?"

lines.speaker: Daniel
lines.en: "Yes, a coffee with milk, please."

lines.speaker: Marta
lines.en: "And a croissant?"

lines.speaker: Daniel
lines.en: "No, today a toast with tomato."
Marta prepares the toast.

lines.speaker: Marta
lines.en: "Do you work a lot?" asks Marta.

lines.speaker: Daniel
lines.en: "Yes, I work many hours in the office."

lines.speaker: Daniel
lines.en: "But I like my work."

lines.speaker: Marta
lines.en: "What do you do?" asks Marta.

lines.speaker: Daniel
lines.en: "I'm an architect. I design houses."

lines.speaker: Marta
lines.en: "How interesting!" says Marta.
Daniel drinks his coffee and looks at Marta.

lines.speaker: Daniel
lines.en: "And you? Do you always work here?"

lines.speaker: Marta
lines.en: "Yes, the café is mine," says Marta.

lines.speaker: Daniel
lines.en: "It's a beautiful café," says Daniel.
Marta smiles and feels happy.
Marta works with her friend Lucía.
Lucía is young and very funny.

lines.speaker: Lucía
lines.en: "Who is that man?" asks Lucía.

lines.speaker: Marta
lines.en: "He's Daniel, a new customer," answers Marta.

lines.speaker: Lucía
lines.en: "He's very handsome," says Lucía with a smile.
Marta laughs but doesn't answer.
The café is full this morning.
Many people want breakfast.
A woman orders an orange juice.
Another man wants a Spanish omelette.
Marta and Lucía work fast.

lines.speaker: Lucía
lines.en: "I'm very tired," says Lucía.

lines.speaker: Marta
lines.en: "Me too, but I like the work," says Marta.
At twelve the café is calm again.
Lucía makes two coffees for them.

lines.speaker: Lucía
lines.en: "Do you like Daniel?" asks Lucía.
Marta doesn't say anything.

lines.speaker: Marta
lines.en: "A little," she answers finally.
Lucía laughs and hugs her friend.

lines.speaker: Lucía
lines.en: "You have to invite him!" says Lucía.
The next morning Daniel arrives early.
He's a bit nervous.

lines.speaker: Daniel
lines.en: "Marta, can I ask you something?" says Daniel.

lines.speaker: Marta
lines.en: "Of course," answers Marta.

lines.speaker: Daniel
lines.en: "Do you want to have dinner with me tonight?"
Marta is surprised but happy.

lines.speaker: Marta
lines.en: "Yes, I'd love to," she answers.

lines.speaker: Daniel
lines.en: "Perfect. At nine, in the restaurant on the square?"

lines.speaker: Marta
lines.en: "Very good. See you tonight."
Daniel leaves the café content.
Lucía looks at Marta and laughs.

lines.speaker: Lucía
lines.en: "You have a date!" says Lucía.

lines.speaker: Marta
lines.en: "Yes, I'm a little nervous," says Marta.

lines.speaker: Lucía
lines.en: "You're going to have a great time," says Lucía.
In the afternoon Marta goes home.
She chooses a pretty dress.
She looks at herself in the mirror.

lines.speaker: Marta
lines.en: "Am I ready?" she thinks.
At nine she arrives at the restaurant.
Daniel is waiting for her with flowers.
The restaurant is small and romantic.
They sit at a table near the window.
A waiter brings the menu.

lines.speaker: Daniel
lines.en: "What do you want to drink?" asks Daniel.

lines.speaker: Marta
lines.en: "A glass of red wine, please."
Daniel orders wine and water.

lines.speaker: Daniel
lines.en: "The fish here is very good," says Daniel.
Marta orders fish and Daniel chicken.
They talk about their families.

lines.speaker: Marta
lines.en: "I have a brother and a sister," says Marta.

lines.speaker: Daniel
lines.en: "I don't have siblings," says Daniel.

lines.speaker: Daniel
lines.en: "I live alone, but I have many friends."
The food arrives and it's delicious.
They laugh and talk for hours.

lines.speaker: Marta
lines.en: "I'm having a very good time," says Marta.

lines.speaker: Daniel
lines.en: "Me too," answers Daniel.
At the end Daniel asks for the bill.

lines.speaker: Marta
lines.en: "Thank you for the dinner," says Marta.

lines.speaker: Daniel
lines.en: "Thank you for coming," says Daniel.
They leave the restaurant together.
Monday Daniel has a difficult day.
There's a problem at the office.
His boss is angry.

lines.speaker: Boss
lines.en: "We need the project today," says the boss.
Daniel works all day without a break.
He doesn't have time to eat.
In the afternoon he's very tired.
He thinks about Marta and the café.
He wants to see her.
At six Daniel finishes the work.
He goes to the café quickly.
Marta sees his tired face.

lines.speaker: Marta
lines.en: "What's wrong?" asks Marta.

lines.speaker: Daniel
lines.en: "A bad day at work," answers Daniel.

lines.speaker: Marta
lines.en: "Sit down. I'll make you a coffee."
Marta prepares a coffee and a cake.

lines.speaker: Daniel
lines.en: "Thank you, Marta. You're very kind."
Daniel drinks the coffee and relaxes.

lines.speaker: Daniel
lines.en: "With you everything is better," he says.
Marta smiles and takes his hand.
It's raining a lot in Madrid.
The café is empty this morning.
Marta looks through the window.
There are no customers.
Suddenly Daniel arrives, wet.

lines.speaker: Daniel
lines.en: "It's raining a lot!" he says, laughing.

lines.speaker: Marta
lines.en: "You don't have an umbrella?" asks Marta.

lines.speaker: Daniel
lines.en: "No, I forgot it at home."
Marta gives him a towel.

lines.speaker: Marta
lines.en: "Sit down here, near me."
They drink coffee and listen to the rain.

lines.speaker: Marta
lines.en: "I like these calm days," says Marta.

lines.speaker: Daniel
lines.en: "Me too, with you," says Daniel.
Daniel takes Marta's hand.

lines.speaker: Daniel
lines.en: "Marta, I like you a lot."
Marta looks at him and smiles.

lines.speaker: Marta
lines.en: "I like you too," she answers.
Outside it keeps raining.
But inside the café there's warmth.
The two are happy together.
It's spring in Madrid.
Daniel and Marta are together every day.
This morning Daniel has news.

lines.speaker: Daniel
lines.en: "I have a new job," says Daniel.

lines.speaker: Daniel
lines.en: "Now I work near the café."

lines.speaker: Marta
lines.en: "That's wonderful!" says Marta.

lines.speaker: Daniel
lines.en: "Now I can come every morning."
Marta is very happy.

lines.speaker: Marta
lines.en: "And I have an idea for the café," she says.

lines.speaker: Marta
lines.en: "I want to open a small terrace."

lines.speaker: Marta
lines.en: "People can eat outside in summer."

lines.speaker: Daniel
lines.en: "It's a great idea," says Daniel.

lines.speaker: Daniel
lines.en: "I can help you on the weekends."
Lucía arrives and hears everything.

lines.speaker: Lucía
lines.en: "You two are a great team," says Lucía.
They all laugh together.
Daniel kisses Marta.

lines.speaker: Daniel
lines.en: "I'm very happy with you," he says.

lines.speaker: Marta
lines.en: "Me too," answers Marta.
And in the Café Luna, a new story begins.
